long_description:
Happy Diwali 🪔✨

Dukaan to Table brings together dozens of South Asian brands in one place, and this Diwali we're bringing that community offline 💛

We're hosting a small group of creators for an evening featuring:

* A mini marketplace

* Snacks and sweets

* Diya painting

* Good music

* A little goodie bag to take home

We'd love for you to capture and share moments from the evening and tag @DukaanToTable 🎊

Please confirm your attendance by Tuesday, 10/13! 

We look forward to celebrating with you 🧡 

Also check out other Arts events in New York, Fine Arts events in New York.
